text:
Maia: FYI  client Nebula wants a POC but security insisted on an explicit key rotation playbook and revocation test. They asked for a runbook we can hand to their infra team. Can we assemble one? cc @sam_se @priya_security
Sam_SE: We have a runbook template. Key points: ephemeral keys only, service account for rotation, programmatic rotate API, revocation CLI + API, one-time handoff link, audit log export. What's Nebulas test window?
Maia: They want to run a revoke test on Thurs during the POC. They also want logs exported to their S3 for the duration.
Priya_Security: For the revoke test we need to set expectations: revocation is immediate in our control plane but there may be a short in-flight window depending on client-side caching. We'll document TTLs for caches and recommend clients honor 401s quickly. Also they should run the revoke test during a low-traffic window.
Luca_Engineering: Draft runbook steps: 1) Provision ephemeral keys for two engineers with 24h TTL. 2) Deliver via signed one-time link. 3) Configure audit export for the Nebula S3 bucket and provide the path. 4) Set up rotate service account in Nebula's CI with minimum permissions. 5) Revoke test: Sam triggers revoke from Console/CLI while Nebula monitors requests; confirm 401s and audit entry. 6) Postmortem: collect logs and timeline.
Sam_SE: CLI/commands to include in runbook:
```
# create key
redwood keys create --type ephemeral --expires 24h --scopes generate --note "nebula-poc-dev1"
# programmatic rotate
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/:alias/rotate
# revoke
redwood keys revoke <key-id>
```
Maia: I'll merge this into the Nebula onboarding doc and send to their infra. Can you also include guidance on how they should configure their retry/backoff logic so revocation is observed?
Priya_Security: Add note: ensure your clients don't cache keys longer than TTL, use short-lived in-memory caches, and respect 401 responses by re-fetching credentials. Also include contact: security@redwood.ai for incidents.
Luca_Engineering: We should attach the small lambda example that rotates the key and writes to AWS Secrets Manager. I'll link the snippet.
Sam_SE: I'll set up a one-time link for Nebula with 15m download TTL. We'll provision 2 keys at 24h TTL and label them nebula-poc-dev1/dev2.
Maia: Great. I'll schedule the revoke test and send the runbook. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
Priya_Security: I'll review the runbook and SecQ answers once you post them.
Maia: Will do.
